columns.name: PROCESS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the transformations that need to be performed on this row.  If the PROCESS_CODE contains a P, then the input values contain a CCID from which a segment value will need to be pulled.  If the PROCESS_CODE contains a M, then a mapping set needs to be applied.  If the PROCESS_CODE contains an A, then the input values contain a CCIDfrom which a segment value will need to be pulled before the mapping set is applied. If the PROCESS_CODE contains a C, then chart of accounts mapping of CCIDs is necessary.  If the PROCESS_CODE contains a S, then chart of accounts mapping of segments is necessary.  The PROCESS_CODE can also contain combinations of these, in which case the P will always be first (if it is present), the M will always be next (if it is present), the A will always be next (if it is present), the S will always be next (if it is present), and the C will always be last (if it is present).
